siteSettings.title: English Adventures: Some - Any - A Little - A Few

lesson.title: Some - Any - A Little - A Few

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Quantity Words Lessons
modules.instructions: Master the use of SOME, ANY, A LITTLE, and A FEW for expressing quantities. Learn positive vs negative contexts and countable vs uncountable nouns.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using SOME, ANY, A LITTLE, and A FEW correctly. Practice with positive and negative contexts.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing the correct quantity word based on context and noun type.

modules.name: Quiz
modules.title: Quick Quiz
modules.instructions: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions about quantity words. Choose the correct quantifier!

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Quantity Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply quantity words correctly in sentences. Master positive vs negative contexts and noun types.
